title: GUN STAT CARD ON PICKUP
why: His feature 17 of 2026-10-12, better gun stat cards, and his answer 34: the card shows on pickup and in the backpack. This is the pickup half. Every gun you pick up now puts up a card for four seconds at the right edge: the gun name in its rarity colour, UPGRADE, DOWNGRADE or SIDEGRADE against the gun in your hands, then damage, rate, magazine, range and handling, each with the difference (green better, red worse), and where the gun went (in hand, a key, the backpack). It is twice the size at 4K so it reads on a TV, and it hides while the backpack or the map is open. In the arcade a gun scrapped for points shows no card.
now: Picking up a gun now shows a stat card that says if it is an upgrade, with damage, rate, magazine, range and handling.
